method: New production drawings generated with OpenAI image_gen; original PNG sources retained. WebP delivery uses Sharp for resizing and encoding, without cropping or redrawing.

assets.name: entrance-desktop
assets.brief: Independent landscape production scene. Asymmetric mossy arch and old oak to the right, upper-left light, ochre path toward an open lower-left landing. Colored pencil and wax crayon on warm paper. No text, UI, people or embedded character. Not a crop of the concept board.

assets.name: entrance-mobile
assets.brief: Independent square composition of the same portal and oak, with the same light and paper material. Recompose portal and canopy in the upper-right; retain open lower-left landing. Full scene at narrow widths, not an automated landscape crop.

assets.name: paperkeeper.three-quarter
assets.brief: Same Paperkeeper identity: asymmetric leaf hat, tiny eyes, moss cape, twig legs, smaller worn shoes, paper satchel on viewer-left, acorn lantern on viewer-right. Neutral standing pose, separate transparent layer, no ground or baked shadow. Follow-up imagegen edit cleans silhouette fringes while preserving pose and proportions.

notes: Production briefs above summarize intent; they are not a claim to recover the missing original V2 master.
PNG and WebP byte hashes, dimensions, alpha bounds and foot baseline are recorded in manifest.json.
Only Entrance uses these assets. Other chapter artwork and existing character studies remain historical baseline until their assigned revision.
